steps.sql: CREATE TABLE jm(id int,j json); INSERT jm VALUES(1,N'{"a":1}'); UPDATE t SET t.j.modify('$.a',2) FROM jm AS t; SELECT j FROM jm;
CREATE TABLE jm(id int,j json); INSERT jm VALUES(1,N'{"a":1}'); UPDATE t SET missing.j.modify('$.a',2) FROM jm AS t; SELECT j FROM jm;
CREATE TABLE jm(id int,j json); INSERT jm VALUES(1,N'{"a":1}'); EXEC(N'CREATE VIEW jv AS SELECT j AS renamed,id FROM dbo.jm'); UPDATE jv SET renamed.modify('$.a',2); SELECT j FROM jm;
CREATE TABLE jm(j json); INSERT jm VALUES(N'{"a":1}'); UPDATE jm SET j.modify('$.a',2),j=N'{"a":3}'; SELECT j FROM jm;
CREATE TABLE jm(j json,p nvarchar(30)); INSERT jm VALUES(N'{"a":1}',NULL),(N'{"a":2}',N'$.a'); UPDATE jm SET j.modify(p,3); SELECT j,@@ROWCOUNT AS row_count FROM jm ORDER BY CAST(j AS nvarchar(max));

CREATE TABLE jm(id int,j json); INSERT jm VALUES(1,N'{"a":1}'),(2,NULL); BEGIN TRY UPDATE jm SET j.modify('$.a',2); END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS number,ERROR_STATE() AS state; END CATCH; SELECT id,j FROM jm ORDER BY id;
CREATE TABLE jm(j json); INSERT jm VALUES(N'{"a":1}'); BEGIN TRAN; UPDATE jm SET j.modify('$.a',2); ROLLBACK; SELECT j FROM jm;

CREATE TABLE jm(id int PRIMARY KEY,j json); INSERT jm VALUES(1,N'{"a":1}'); MERGE jm AS t USING (SELECT 1 AS id,2 AS v) AS s ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET j.modify('$.a',s.v); SELECT j FROM jm;

CREATE TABLE jm(id int PRIMARY KEY,j json); INSERT jm VALUES(1,N'{"a":1}'); MERGE jm AS t USING (SELECT 1 AS id,2 AS v) AS s ON t.id=s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET j.modify('$.a',s.v) OUTPUT deleted.j,inserted.j; SELECT j FROM jm;
CREATE TABLE jm(j json); DECLARE @i int=NULL; INSERT jm VALUES(@i); SELECT j FROM jm;
